answer.worked: The given angle TCB is $125^\circ$. The alternate segment theorem for chord TB gives $\beta=\angle QTB=125^\circ$. Since T,C,B,A are concyclic, opposite angles TCB and TAB are supplementary, so $\alpha=180^\circ-125^\circ=55^\circ$.
